description_en: A long chaise lounge with one raised back and an extended woven leg deck, carrying a single shaped cushion; the front shows the continuous lounging surface, the side reveals the reclining back-to-foot contour, and the rear exposes the high back frame above the low base. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
